inference.runtime: Same pinned torch/transformers CPU runtime and four model snapshots as initial local NLI cohort
inference.input: Only ordered premise and hypothesis; no gold label, heuristic, split, template or subcase
inference.prediction: Argmax of float32 logits in exact config id2label order, lowest-index tie
inference.failure_policy: No silent retry, replacement, imputation or overwrite; require all four complete candidates

analysis.winner_source: Recompute original imposed and repaired unique WSC35 winners from hash-pinned original analysis summary; tied winners yield null contrast
analysis.metric: Macro mean of 30 subcase accuracies (20 each); equals micro on balanced sample
analysis.contrast: Repaired-selected minus imposed-selected HANS600 accuracy, including zero/negative
analysis.secondary: Six heuristic x binary-gold cells and three heuristic accuracies

bootstrap.stratification: heuristic x binary gold, five subcases per cell, paired candidate resampling

scope: Same public HANS benchmark, 58 syntactic templates; pretraining exposure unknown. Not independent evidence that WSC's curated recast has official three-way NLI gold or that a real user chose a model.
